Y.summary: Nemesis studies the role of the L2 norm of learnable soft prompts in CLIP-style vision-language models. It proposes PUN, a uniform L2-norm regulariser over all prompt positions, and PAN, a position-aware variant that performs a per-batch pre-inference step to select which prompt positions to regularise. Experiments report a +1.8 base-to-new harmonic-mean gain on the 11-dataset few-shot benchmark.
